## Configuration File Location

Palworld dedicated server settings can be changed by editing the PalWorldSettings.ini file located in the /Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/ directory on your server. On Windows, the file is located at `steamapps\common\PalServer\Pal\Saved\Config\WindowsServer\PalWorldSettings.ini`.

## Important Configuration Notes

First, editing DefaultPalWorldSettings.ini does nothing — you have to copy its contents into the file above and edit that one.

A critical gotcha for Palworld 1.0: Once your world has been generated, the server stores most world settings in WorldOption.sav and stops reading them from the ini. ## Key Settings to Adjust

Common settings you can modify include:
- EnemyDropItemRate to make combat more rewarding
- CollectionDropRate if gathering feels slow
- For most settings with rate values, 1.000000 value is the default, so changing to 0.500000 would halve the time and 2.000000 would double the time
